translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Irbogus Garda Narmaksad 2 Corintios

content: ¿Degite, anmar na dukin san-ogannoged guarmarsii? Ar igi baigan imakdamala, e-daed-barsognaid-garda na sesdamala, ¿deyob an bese sedabi be an-abemarsunde, igi, be-garda deyob baiganse sedbi be an-abemarsunde?
Ar bemar anmar-gardayob gumalad, bemar anmar-gwagegi narmakar nanaid. Bela mag be-dakmalad, degine, bela-dulemar be-absogedbimalad, anmar bemar-odurdakdiid bela nueganbi gumarye.

Ar bemar Cristo-garda-narmaksad gumalad, anmar we-garda-uksamalad, we-narmaklesad tintagi narmaklearsulid. Narmakaledi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-dula-maidgi narmakaled. Akwagi epenne igi narmaklesa, deyob narmaklearsurbalid. Narmakaledi, dulemar-gwage-dula-naidgi.
Ar we-ibmar anmar Bab-Dummad-asabin Cristoba bensulid, we-an-bemarga-sogedi, napiragwadid.
Anmar bela an na sunna ibmar dukin imakmar-deeye an sogsurdo. Suli, degisuli. Bab-Dummad-anmarga-gangued-ukmaidba sunna bela anmar ibmar-imaked.

Degine, Bab Dummad na e anmarga uksad, igar-binid-megisad e-maiga sunna anmar guega, ibmar-narmaklealidbarsurdo, suli, burbaledbardo. Ar epenne garda-sanar-narmaklesaddi sunna dule-oburgwed, ar igar-biniddi burbaledid, adi dule-odulogedid.

Ar we-igar-gebed dule-oburgwed-inigwele, uklesgu, gandikidba-gae uklesad, deun we-igar akwagi-narmakar uklesgu, degisoggu, Israel-dulemar Moisés-e-wagar geg-dake-gusmalad, ar ade Moisés-wagar gandikidba-dakar-maked-ular geg e-wagar dake-gusmalad, ar wedi berguoen-inigwer.
Degisoggu, we-igar-burbaled-bursunna, bur-bule yeer-daklegedba nued uklesdo.
Ar we-igar dule-sabsur-odurdaked yeer-daklegedba uklesadde, ar igar dule-iskussulidyob-imaked-bursunna, bur-bule yeer-dakle uklesdo.
We-igar-yeer-daklegedba ukles-inigwele, degite nued barsurdo, we bur nue-yeer-dakle-danikoed-ebo be dakder, danikoedi bur-bule nue-yeer-dakle-danikoed.
Ar ibmar-sunna-bergued nue-yeer-daklegedba nabir gusadde, ar ibmar-degi-sadeguoed-bursunna, bur-bule nue-yeer-daklegedba guodo.
Ar degisoggu, degi anmar bensulidgine edarbedisoggu, inikigwadba anmar dobsuli ibmar sogsundo.
Anmar Moisésyob imaksulid, adi e-wagar-idu dunwed nasik-daed, adi melle Israel-dulemar e-wagar-dakarmaknaid-bergumaid dakegar.
Ar Israel-dulemar ibmar-aku-ito nadmalad, amba emise-bakale, idu-igar-megisad absodmalale, dunwe-e-idu nasiklesadyob amba e-idu naid, ar ade Cristobi a-dunwed unnila osuloged.
Amba emi-ibase, Israel-dulemar Moisés-igar-mesisad absodmalale, amba e-gwage-idu dunweyob naid.
Ar we Israel-dulemar Bab-Jesúsba-nagunonimalardi we-dunweyob-naid ega surgunoni-daed.
Ar Bab-Jesúsde Burba-Nuedid. Degisoggu, bia Bab-Jesús-Burba gudii, agine, dulemar bela-ibmargi ollorgunoni-dasunnad.

Degisoggu, bela anmar-wagar-idu ibmar bar naisursoggu, anmar ispeyobsundo, Bab-Jesús-e-gandik-gaed anmar oyonaisundo. Degisoggu, anmar gatik Cristoyob dakledanisunnad, ar a-e-yeer-dakleged bur-bule anmar nikumaidba. Weyob Bab-Jesús-Burba-Nued ibmar saed.
